description.id: Kata pertama untuk menyapa, berterima kasih, minta maaf, dan bertanya kabar.
description.en: First words for greeting, thanking, apologising and asking after someone.

description.id: Kata ganti orang, memperkenalkan nama, dan kalimat dasar "A adalah B".
description.en: Pronouns, introducing your name and the basic "A is B" sentence.

description.id: Angka dari nol sampai sepuluh, "dua" yang dipakai untuk menghitung, dan bertanya "berapa".
description.en: Numbers from zero to ten, the counting form "two" and asking "how many".

description.id: Menunjuk benda dan tempat, serta mengatakan ada, tidak ada, dan berada di mana.
description.en: Pointing at things and places, and saying something is, is not, or is located somewhere.

description.id: Kata tanya (apa, siapa, mana, bagaimana) dan cara menjawab.
description.en: Question words (what, who, which, how) and how to answer.

description.id: Ratusan dan ribuan, nomor urut, usia, serta kata untuk banyak, sedikit, dan setengah.
description.en: Hundreds and thousands, ordinals, age, and words for many, few and half.

description.id: Menyebut teman, teman sekelas, laki-laki, perempuan, dan anak-anak.
description.en: Naming friends, classmates, men, women and children.

description.id: Anggota keluarga, tempat tinggal, perabot, dan hewan peliharaan.
description.en: Family members, where you live, furniture and pets.

description.id: Makan, minum, dan hidangan sehari-hari.
description.en: Eating, drinking and everyday dishes.

description.id: Hari ini, besok, minggu, bulan, dan tahun.
description.en: Today, tomorrow, weeks, months and years.

description.id: Menyebut jam dan menit, bagian hari, dan menanyakan waktu.
description.en: Telling the hour and minutes, parts of the day, and asking about time.

description.id: Atas, bawah, depan, belakang, dalam, luar, serta pergi, datang, pulang, dan tiba.
description.en: Up, down, front, back, inside, outside, and going, coming, returning and arriving.

description.id: Toko, restoran, bioskop, kantor, dan kendaraan.
description.en: Shops, restaurants, the cinema, offices and vehicles.

description.id: Bangun, berpakaian, makan, memasak, tidur, dan kata bantu untuk "sudah", "sedang", dan "lagi".
description.en: Getting up, dressing, eating, cooking, sleeping, and the helpers for "already", "currently" and "again".

description.id: Menyatakan suka, ingin, bisa, boleh, tahu, dan merasa.
description.en: Saying what you like, want, can, may, know and feel.

description.id: Sekolah, guru, murid, pelajaran, dan jenjang pendidikan.
description.en: School, teachers, students, lessons and school levels.

description.id: Negara, bahasa, huruf, serta berbicara, membaca, menulis, melihat, dan mendengar.
description.en: Countries, language, characters, and speaking, reading, writing, seeing and hearing.

description.id: Bekerja, istirahat, sakit, ke dokter, dan menenangkan "tidak apa-apa".
description.en: Working, resting, being ill, seeing a doctor and saying "no problem".

description.id: Membeli, menjual, harga, uang, dan benda yang dibeli.
description.en: Buying, selling, prices, money and things you buy.

description.id: Film, lagu, telepon, komputer, dan hal-hal yang menyenangkan.
description.en: Films, songs, phones, computers and things that are fun.

description.id: Besar, kecil, baru, cantik, panas, dingin, hujan, salju, dan kata penguat.
description.en: Big, small, new, pretty, hot, cold, rain, snow and intensifiers.
